verbatimSupport.quote: Reuse the admin drawer’s focus-management approach
verbatimSupport.atomicMeaning: Custom/admin branch of explicit or

support.verbatimFullLine: 1. **[P1] Make student dialogs work with a keyboard.** In desktop and mobile renders, opening Settings left focus on the toolbar button behind it. Pressing **Tab** went to the background Dashboard button. Settings also declares a tab list without exposing the individual tab roles and selected state. Reuse the admin drawer’s focus-management approach or the support form’s native dialog pattern. Give close buttons accessible names and implement keyboard navigation for the tabs. [Tracker modal code](<js/app.js:1839>) · [W3C dialog pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/) · [W3C tabs pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/)
support.comment: Custom/admin branch of explicit or

support.previousStructuredQuote: - Fix unintended root document overflow.

verbatimSupport.quote: **[P1] Fix mobile overflow around the roadmap, course list, and report.**
verbatimSupport.atomicMeaning: Root viewport scope includes all three named areas

support.verbatimFullLine: 2. **[P1] Fix mobile overflow around the roadmap, course list, and report.** At a **360 px** viewport, the tracker document measured **441 px** wide. The roadmap can legitimately pan inside its own container, but the surrounding page should stay within the viewport. Keep the PDF preview’s print proportions inside a contained viewer, and make the mobile navigation reveal that there are more destinations. [Mobile roadmap rules](<css/style.css:2760>) · [W3C reflow guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html)
support.comment: Root viewport scope includes all three named areas

support.previousStructuredQuote: - Load the PDF engine when export is requested.

verbatimSupport.quote: Load it when the student requests export
verbatimSupport.atomicMeaning: PDF engine has an explicit preceding antecedent

support.verbatimFullLine: - **[P2] Load expensive extras when needed.** The bundled PDF engine is about **885 KiB uncompressed** and loads on tracker startup. Load it when the student requests export and show a preparing state. Likewise, sign-in can show its static background immediately and load WebGL only when appropriate. These are code-level findings; I didn’t measure production load times. [Tracker scripts](<index.html:605>) · [Sign-in scripts](<auth.html:378>)
support.comment: PDF engine has an explicit preceding antecedent

support.previousStructuredQuote: - Use local SVG icons for essential actions.

support.verbatimFullLine: - **[P2] Keep core controls recognizable when external assets fail.** With external requests blocked, several icon-only buttons appeared blank. Use local SVGs or visible fallback labels for essential actions, and give every heading an explicit font fallback. For maintenance, keep the illustration but make the heading communicate **“Scheduled maintenance”** on its own; the current `h1` is only “better.” [Maintenance heading](<maintenance.html:94>)
support.comment: Essential-action SVG alternative
